project.name: acme-app
project.summary: Example product repository used as an eval fixture for adopt-repo-standards qualification runs.

goals: Serve as a deterministic qualification fixture for adopt-repo-standards adoption cycles.
Expose the complete engineering baseline surfaces: runtime constitution projection, project manifest, fences, and a conformance entrypoint.
Keep the repository minimal, self-contained, and verifiable with a single deterministic command.
nonGoals: Implement product application features or capabilities.
Own organization-wide adoption, work, or control-plane state.
Publish packages, deploy services, or operate live runtime infrastructure.

owns.name: Engineering baseline fixture
owns.description: Owns the adopted baseline surfaces (constitution projection, manifest, fences, conformance entrypoint) used to qualify adopt-repo-standards runs.

doesNotOwn: Product application code or runtime behavior.
Live deployments, release artifacts, or package publication.
Organization-wide adoption, work-ledger, or control-plane state.

publicSurfaces.name: conformance
publicSurfaces.description: Deterministic repository-baseline conformance entrypoint; exits nonzero on any drift.

forbiddenCouplings: Legacy instruction layouts acting as active authority.
Org-wide policy or control-plane defaults authored repo-locally.
Cross-repository internal access; all coupling goes through declared surfaces.

gaps.description: No product code exists in this fixture, so the canonical code-architecture surface (Capability-first Modular DDD, Clean/Hexagonal, FCIS) is not applicable until code lands.
gaps.exitCondition: Product code lands and is migrated against the Sylphx engineering standard with npm run check green.

delivery.terminalBoundary: Default-branch source landing with the conformance entrypoint green; no package publication, deployment, or live runtime.
